protocol.hypothesis: Account-specific timing distributions may prefer different SVM regularization and kernel widths.
protocol.classification: adapted baseline optimization; not SOTA reproduction
protocol.historical_exposure: Legacy CMU sessions historically explored; earlier global-model dev summaries already seen. This follow-up is not independent confirmation and no pristine holdout claim is made.
protocol.decision_scope: Existing TRAIN-only candidate grid; no candidate/threshold/feature choices from any new dev observations.
protocol.selection: Each account minimizes EER on sessions2and3; exact ties resolved by listed candidate order.
protocol.enrollment: Exactly first10 repetitions of session1; no refit after selection
protocol.feature_schema: Unchanged strict CMU schema excluding Enter, milliseconds; same fit_model and distances
protocol.background: Unchanged original SVM implementation: other-account session1-2 arrays supplied, first10 rows per other account used as negative fit and population scaling.
protocol.calibration: Session4 only; freeze account-specific EER/FAR1%/FAR5% thresholds using original threshold_for
protocol.validation_condition: Stop after training and report. Any later dev comparison must use identical sessions5-6 and enrollment, frozen thresholds, paired account uncertainty; no automatic promotion from training EER.

validation_plan.caveat: Legacy and prior global-dev exposure; exploratory follow-up. Account bootstrap does not fully model dependence from shared impostor probes.

score_artifact_direction: larger_is_impostor; research API negates to larger_is_genuine
